pr_body:
S.S.C.Pkcs.ContentInfo..ctor(byte[]) didn't get spanified because it holds
a reference to the array, and returns it via a property.

S.S.C.Pkcs's AsnEncodedData-derived types didn't get spanified because
that package currently doesn't have a net5 TFM, and this doesn't feel
significant enough to warrant adding one.

Fixes #38348.

> (I tried implementing it myself as internal but it was non-trivial on macOS)

Yeah, it took some plumbing changes, but all of the guts are ReadOnlySpan now (I have everything implemented already, except the feature that, y'know, _just_ got added).

review_comments: This should have a disclaimer along the lines of "We assume everybody who uses an instance of this type is well-behaved, that they always call Dispose exactly once for every instance of this type which is created, and that no thread attempts to call Dispose while another thread is still using this object. Violating this could corrupt the array pool or could lead to AV."

The problem, of course, is that it's an infectious feature; and I'd need to write support for it in the code generator.  It would definitely allow for some simplified code calling (and reduce risk), and I have some ideas for how to do it without too much overhead.

So it'll definitely be on my mind as a cleanup effort / future impact.
